name: China Lake Grenade Launcher
description_html:
Chunky, Heavy and definitely will take a lot of your hideout space

Description

A legendary and well known weapon made during the 60s, a rare commodity made with limited numbers. The China Lake is a heavy pump action grenade launcher that can store up to 3 round (4 including the one in the chamber).

Can be obtained from PMC and Scav AI (Low % of being equipped)
Can be obtained from cultist circle sacrifices (can be exchanged up to 5 times, 1 each with a Specific item)
Requested by Colette Blackpaw
